value.name: Source Cistern
value.desc: Rain water stacked three marks high. Valve A on the pipe east toward WORK. Closed, nothing flows. Open, gravity takes a mark each wait.
hooks: Valve-A: pipe to WORK. Say open valve or close valve.
Pump-Janitor: Check valve holds. I will not fill OUT from a bucket.

value.name: The Sight-Glass Gallery
value.desc: Three tanks behind glass: SOURCE, WORK, OUT. Clear pipes. Gravity is the only computer. A plaque: height is the computation. A bucket on a far hook would be a lie.
hooks: Plaque: height is the computation. A bucket into OUT is not a win.
Pump-Janitor: I move water. I do not pour. Hire me and I tick once.

value.name: Output Cistern
value.desc: The answer tank. Empty glass. A wooden bucket hangs here — the cheat. Pouring fills the height without the pipes. Physics will call it DISPUTED. A downstream door: glass, impossible, north-bank cold. It only opens for carried height.
hooks: The Bucket: pour bucket to fake a height. That is not computation.

hooks: Valve-B: pipe to OUT. Open only after water has arrived, or both valves siphon.
